summary: Neurogene Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 3,500,000 common shares and 666,666 pre-funded warrants at $30.00 per share, raising ~$125M ($117.5M net before expenses). The offering is an underwritten secondary issuance, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction. The role is issuer. The transaction is a standard equity raise for a pharmaceutical company.
